pose: A playful 3/4 'Center-Pillar' stance. The dinosaur is balanced on one leg, with the other hind leg raised in a 'karate' pose, pointing the toe-claw toward the center-line. The head is at the top of the 1024px frame, looking down at its foot with a friendly smirk. The body is angled slightly inward so the raised leg and the torso stay within a narrow 300px horizontal zone, preventing truncation in the 340px wide crop.

character_details.expression: Signature friendly smirk, looking playfully at a small bee.
character_details.skin_texture: Smooth, high-poly 3D surfaces; no grain or sharp edges.

environmental_details.ground: Sun-bleached clay with a single Magnolia flower near the standing foot.
environmental_details.interaction: A small, fuzzy bee is perched on the 'softened' toe-claw; the dinosaur is gently urging it toward the flower.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Warm cinematic midday sun with golden rim-lighting to define the pose.
